messages:
Noor (Partnerships): Heads-up: running a joint Cloud+Edge Interop webinar/demo next Wed. Need to finalize speaker order, embargo timing for the joint announcement, demo failovers, and swag packing list with partner co-branding. Can folks confirm by EOD Tue?
Priya (Marketing): I can own the embargo language. Proposed timeline: partners sign off by Tue noon, press embargo lifts Wed 2pm PT (post-demo). Partners ok with that?
Caleb (Marketplace): AcmeCloud and NovaSI say yes to Wed 2pm embargo lift. We need the marketplace listing link and short blurb ready beforehand for marketplace team to approve. I'll queue it.
Yui (Hardware): Shipping note: hardware arrives Thu. We want to stage 2 demo rigs + 1 warm standby. Also requesting foam inserts to protect edge boxes. Can logistics confirm customs docs?
Sam (Events): Booking courier for hardware. Also need table layout for demo lanes and a locked cabinet for partner devices. Volunteers for swag: 09:30-11:00, 11:00-13:30, 13:30-15:30. Need two per slot. Priya can you staff morning?
Priya (Marketing): Yes to morning. I'll recruit one more from growth. Also suggest RFID-tagged swag bundles for partner tracking (just scan on pickup). Partners ok?
Noor (Partnerships): RFID is cool but confirm partners are comfortable with scanning. We'll make it opt-in and display privacy note. Add to runbook.
DevOps Bot: Network ops: will pre-provision a dedicated /29 for demo VLAN and schedule warmup pings for hosted fallback endpoint starting 30m pre-demo. Confirm region for fallback?
Caleb (Marketplace): Use region=us-west-2 for fallback. Also add a reduced-rate throttling policy: max 25rps and model=redwood-lite-quant.
Yui (Hardware): Fallback plan for hardware demos: 1) switch to partner pre-recorded clip (60s), 2) if still down, show annotated screenshots + narrate. I'll upload clips by Tue 10:00.
Noor (Partnerships): Great. Please ensure each partner has a static fallback slide and a 60s clip. Add privacy blurbs to slides.
Sam (Events): AV needs: HDMI matrix (3 inputs), 2 lapel mics, 1 handheld for audience, 1 spare laptop, extra HDMI->USB-C adapters x6. Logistics confirm?
DevOps Bot: Inventory check: HDMI adapters x9, spare laptops x2, lapel mics x3, handhelds x1. Courier TRK-44122 for swag inbound Fri 07:00.
Caleb (Marketplace): Adding curl fallback snippet for partners (paste into partner runbook):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<your prompt>","max_tokens":100}'
```
Priya (Marketing): Swag packing plan: partner co-branded bundles (sticker pack + postcard + promo card). Tees reserved for VIPs only. RFID tag on bundles for analytics. Limit one bundle per person.
Noor (Partnerships): Also partners requested a 30-min integrator clinic after the session (max 12). We have room at 16:30. Priya, can you publish RSVP and short agenda?
Priya (Marketing): Will publish RSVP today and include "what to bring" checklist.
Yui (Hardware): Last ask: request an isolated power circuit for the Dedicated demo rack and 220V IEC leads. Sam please confirm with venue electrical.
Sam (Events): Adding IEC leads x3 and dedicated circuit request to venue. Will confirm by tomorrow morning.
Noor (Partnerships): Thanks all. Final: drop fallback slides/clips in the shared folder, add unresolved items to the runbook comments, and please be in the green room 25m early for the dry run tomorrow. :thumbsup:
